note:
1906 -> 1647, and the whole 259 is this branch clearing what it also made visible.

tsconfig.json mapped three of the seven `@odoo/hoot*` specifiers web/__manifest__.py declares. The four it missed -- hoot-dom-helpers-dom, -events, -time and hoot-dom-utils -- are exactly the four hoot-dom.js imports and re-exports, so every test file received `any` from a library that is carefully JSDoc-typed: `queryAllTexts` declares `@returns {string[]}` and no caller could see it. Mapping them (b0264c0179a) raised the count from 1906 to 2026 by letting the compiler reach code it had never checked. The commits after it cleared those 120 and 139 more.

Nothing was suppressed to get here. The fixes are declarations that had drifted from the contracts they describe -- hoot`s toHaveValue forbidding the RegExp its own prose promises and its _ensureArguments accepts; mockFetch declared `typeof fetch` where the value is awaited and non-Response returns are documented as wrapped; FieldComponent missing the `@template` all 44 subclasses supply; ForwardRef written as `@typedef {Function}` with an @property, which TypeScript reads as neither; RecordTag describing less than its own template consumes; a ListVirtualization typedef shipped beside the class that superseded it -- and invariants a caller enforces that the compiler cannot follow across a boundary.

Measured on a clean tree at HEAD with the pinned TypeScript 5.9.3, `npx tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit | grep -c "error TS"`. The raw count is quoted rather than a gate summary because a syntax error answers with 1 and reads as a clean tree, which happened once on this branch.

The two default-deny lanes moved with it: strict 58 -> 23 regressed files, noimplicitany 56 -> 16, so `typecheck.yml` 114 regressed file-gate pairs -> 39.
